---
name: Add module index draft
about: Pull request template for adding modules
---

This PR adds OS-specific quick reference files and an initial MODULE_INDEX.json to help discover modules across platforms.

Files included:
- ANDROID.md
- WINDOWS.md
- MACOS.md
- LINUX.md
- IOS.md
- DOCKER.md
- MODULE_INDEX.json
- README_MODULES.md
- LICENSE

Please review the templates and suggest edits. If everything looks good, merge to main.
